factual_claims.source_evidence: The comparative base year included one-off profit of 4.0 million euros, of which 2.1 million euros resulted from the revaluation of investment properties and 1.9 million euros from extraordinary profit arising from the sale of two non-core properties in the Group’s real estate segment in Latvia.

factual_claims.claim: Financial discipline remained a focal point, as the Group successfully constrained total operating expenses to a 0.2 percent annual increase and reduced finance costs by 1.5 million euros thanks to lower interest rates linked to Euribor.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Continuous improvement of work processes and optimisation of the supply chain... have helped to keep labour costs under control. Labour costs increased by 3.7% for the year as a whole... The Group has also kept other operating expenses stable, with annual growth of 0.2%... Net profit was positively affected by a decline in interest on the Group’s borrowings, providing relief of 1.5 million euros for the year compared to the previous year.

factual_claims.claim: Cash and cash equivalents stood at 29.5 million euros at year end, while working capital turned negative at minus 14.2 million euros due to the reclassification of maturing long-term loans as current liabilities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: As at the end of the financial year, the Group had cash and cash equivalents amounting to 29,516 thousand euros (2024: 45,454 thousand euros)... As at 31 December 2025, working capital was negative at 14,161 thousand euros (2024: positive 17,422 thousand euros)... At the end of 2025, the volume of short-term loan liabilities increased significantly due to the final instalments of several long-term loans maturing in 2026...

factual_claims.claim: Capital expenditures totaled 25.5 million euros, funding comprehensive refurbishments across key retail locations, IT infrastructure enhancements, and the opening of a combined KIA and Škoda multi-brand dealership in Vilnius.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: The Group’s total investments in 2025 amounted to 25.5 million euros... In the Selver supermarkets business segment, investments of 4.1 million euros were made in 2025... In the department stores business segment, investments amounted to 1.5 million euros... Total investments in the car segment during the reporting period amounted to 2.6 million euros... In the real estate business segment, investments amounted to 14.8 million euros... a new multi-brand car centre was completed in Lithuania, bringing KIA and Škoda sales and service operations together under one roof.

factual_claims.claim: On a group level, annual average employment decreased slightly to 4,743 staff, loyal Partner Card holders surpassed 750,000, and earnings per share declined to 0.43 euros from 0.67 euros.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: At the end of the reporting period, the number of loyal customers exceeded 750 thousand... 4 743 Yearly average number of Employees (2024: 4 769)... 43 Cents Net profit per share (2024: 67 cents).

factual_claims.claim: In early 2026, the Group announced a definitive agreement to acquire Škoda distribution rights in Tallinn and Harju County, reinforcing its long-term automotive expansion strategy.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Event after the reporting period... Group’s subsidiary TKM Auto OÜ will, subject to the fulfilment of the conditions precedent to final completion of the transaction, acquire a 100% interest in three companies engaged in the retail sale and servicing of vehicles: Rohe Auto AS, SKO Motors OÜ, and a real estate holding company...

factual_claims.claim: Additionally, a corporate demerger in Lithuania successfully separated the KIA and Škoda operations into distinct entities.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: A demerger agreement signed in May of the reporting year initiated the demerger of UAB Motus auto... As a result of the demerger, the existing UAB Motus auto continues its operations under the name UAB KIA Auto, focusing on the sale and servicing of KIA vehicles. As of 28 May 2025, the Škoda business line was transferred... to a newly established subsidiary operating under the previously used company name UAB Motus auto.

factual_claims.claim: Although headline profitability weakened against a buoyant comparative base, TKM Grupp maintained steady operational execution, optimized its supply chain, and preserved liquidity through active debt refinancing preparations, positioning the organization for measured recovery as local consumer sentiment gradually stabilizes.
factual_claims.label: SUPPORTED
factual_claims.source_evidence: Through effective cost control, accurate inventory planning and the dedication of its employees, the Group was able to ensure a stable result even in volatile conditions... The Group has also kept other operating expenses stable... The Group continues to have a strong daily operating cash flow as a source for covering its short-term liabilities... In the management’s assessment, the company does not face liquidity issues.
